actions.action: Check soil moisture 3 cm deep with finger
If dry, water slowly until it drains and empty saucer after 10 minutes
Check soil every 2-3 days and water when top 2 cm dry
Set up a pebble tray for humidity
If direct sun hits the plant, move it about 1 m back from the glass
